initialization: Initialize all nodes from motion.json nodes once. For a standalone diagnostic clip, full absolute keys may reset all channels to rest. For simultaneous gameplay layers, only apply the channels explicitly listed here.
priority: Toy_Disabled cancels Travel/Idle/AimYaw/Fire_Recoil/Rocket_Charge; motor_stop stops Travel and can hold the current wheel rotation.
Idle translation and AimYaw rotation can coexist on TurretYaw.
Fire_Recoil modifies only BarrelRecoil.translation; never overwrite TurretYaw with its diagnostic rest channels.
Blend into absolute recipes from current pose when switching states; JSON keys define canonical poses, no controller or gameplay implementation is included.
